data.gender_notes: Asmarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asmarah is derived from the Arabic word ‘asmarah’, meaning ‘beauty’ or ‘love’. In Islamic tradition, it represents the deep, eternal love between Allah and His creation. It is also a symbol of the love and devotion that a mother has for her child. The name Asmarah carries the meaning “Beauty, Love” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asmarah usually hope their child will grow to embody beauty, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the love between Allah and His creation.
data.etymology: Asmarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beauty, Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asmarah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
